shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/rejection-log.test.ts && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short && cat package.json'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('  jsonPointers: boolean;','  jsonPointers?: boolean;')
s=s.replace(\"export class ToolRegistry {\", \"const ajvPackage = createRequire(import.meta.url)('ajv/package.json') as {version: string};\\nconst ajvMajorVersion = Number(ajvPackage.version.split('.')[0]);\\n\\nexport class ToolRegistry {\")
s=s.replace(\"    ...(Number((createRequire(import.meta.url)('ajv/package.json') as {version: string}).version.split('.')[0]) < 8\\n      ? {jsonPointers: true}\\n      : {}),\", \"    ...(ajvMajorVersion < 8 ? {jsonPointers: true} : {}),\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/orchestration/tools/rejection-log.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"    expect(JSON.stringify(warn.mock.calls)).toMatch(/location.*string/);\\n    expect(JSON.stringify(warn.mock.calls)).not.toContain('123456789');\", \"    const logged = JSON.stringify(warn.mock.calls);\\n    expect({pathAndType: /location.*string/.test(logged), containsValue: logged.includes('123456789')}).toEqual({\\n      pathAndType: true,\\n      containsValue: false,\\n    });\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Add unit tests in', '- [x] Repair the latest CI typecheck and lint findings.\\n- [ ] Add unit tests in')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/rejection-log.test.ts .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc 'if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/rejection-log.test.ts && git commit -m 'Fix validator type and lint errors' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
